title: Replica Rescue (demo)

coach.board: Each box is a pod. The meter is your error budget.
coach.firstMove: Add a few replicas before the chaos starts.

events.title: Chaos monkey killed a pod
events.fix: A Deployment's ReplicaSet notices the missing pod and starts a replacement on its own; spare replicas just cover the gap.

events.title: A node went down and took two pods with it
events.fix: Self-healing is not instant, so run spare replicas: losing two pods at once still leaves enough serving.

hints: Look at the pod count and the error budget.
The chaos monkey kills a pod now and then, and a node goes down at tick 8.
Add replicas early so losing a node still leaves enough pods serving.
